title.zh_CN: Vinput ≥ 2.4.0 配置迁移（vinput config migrate）

text.en_US:
【Target: Upgrading to v2.4.0 or newer】
Configuration fields have changed across recent versions. Do not edit config files by hand. Use the built-in migration command (idempotent; originals are copied to backups/ before writing).

▶ Option 1: Fast Reset (if you do not need to keep custom configs)
Run:
  vinput init -f

▶ Option 2: In-place migration (recommended; keeps custom configs)
Preview without writing:
  vinput config migrate --dry-run
Apply:
  vinput config migrate

---
【v2.4.0 Highlights】
- Zero-latency optimistic capture: audio recording starts on physical press, eliminating swallowed leading syllables across Tap and Hold modes (#241).
- Exclusive trigger interception: completely eliminates Firefox/ChatGPT Alt menu bar popups and lost focus during voice triggers (#241).
- Robust Menu key toggle: Shift_R now reliably toggles the command palette on release, while passing modifier chords like Shift+A seamlessly to applications (#241).
- Configuration clean-up: removed obsolete HoldActivationDelay in favor of discrete hardware key release adjudication (#241).
- Pure event-driven state machine: removed fragile timers, resolving auto-repeat interruptions and modifier collision regressions (#241).
text.zh_CN:
【适用版本：升级到 v2.4.0 及以上版本】
近期版本对配置字段做了规范化调整。请不要手工改配置文件，使用内置迁移命令（幂等；写入前会把原文件备份到 backups/）。

▶ 方式一：一键重置（无需保留自定义配置）
在终端执行：
  vinput init -f

▶ 方式二：原地迁移（推荐，保留已有自定义配置）
先预览、不写入：
  vinput config migrate --dry-run
再执行迁移：
  vinput config migrate

---
【v2.4.0 版本说明】
- 零延迟乐观采音：按下触发键瞬间即开启录音，彻底消灭点按和长按模式下的吞首字现象 (#241)。
- 独占热键拦截：输入法层完全独占触发键按压与释放，彻底杜绝 Firefox/ChatGPT 误弹 Alt 菜单栏及焦点丢失 (#241)。
- 菜单键 Toggle 闭环：命令面板热键（Shift_R）单敲支持开/关切换，同时完美放行 Shift+A 等组合键输入 (#241)。
- 配置规范化：移除冗余的 HoldActivationDelay 配置，按键时长由硬件离散事件精准裁决 (#241)。
- 纯事件驱动状态机：彻底消除脆弱的异步定时器，修复长按连击被打断及修饰键状态冲突缺陷 (#241)。
